blocks.prompt: 3 In how many ways can five subjects be selected out of eight subjects to select a course programme?
blocks.explanation:
Course programme subjects ka ek group hai; kaunsa subject pehle chuna aur kaunsa baad mein, is se course nahi badalta.
Diya kya hai? 8 subjects. Find kya karna hai? 5 subjects kitne tareeqon se chune ja sakte hain.
Plan: order ki ahmiyat nahi, is liye yeh combination hai: \({}^{8}C_{5}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 8 subjects, jin mein se 5 chunne hain.
Humein find karna hai: kitne mukhtalif course programmes ban sakte hain.
Tareeqa: Pehla sawal hamesha yeh poochein: kya order se farq parta hai? Physics, Chemistry, Biology ka course aur Biology, Physics, Chemistry ka course ek hi hai. Order se farq nahi parta, is liye combination \({}^{n}C_{r}\), jahan \(n = 8\) aur \(r = 5\).

Combination likhein
\[{}^{8}C_{5} = \dfrac{8!}{5!\,3!}\]
Kyun: Formula \({}^{n}C_{r} = \frac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}\) hai aur \(8 - 5 = 3\).

Cancel kar ke hisaab lagayein
\[= \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5!}{5! \cdot 6}\]
\[= 8 \cdot 7 = 56\]
Kyun: \(8!\) ko \(5!\) tak khola, \(5!\) cancel hua, aur \(3! = 6\) upar wale 6 se cancel ho gaya.
Dhyan dein: Agar aap ne \({}^{8}P_{5} = 6720\) likh diya to aap ne har course ko \(5! = 120\) dafa gin liya. Selection mein permutation nahi lagta.

Tasdeeq
\[{}^{8}C_{5} = {}^{8}C_{3} = \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6}{6} = 56\]
Kyun: 5 subjects lena aur 3 subjects chhorna ek hi faisla hai, is liye dono taraf 56 aata hai.
